{"metadata":{"description":"bubble-explain","id":"gh:1343518181","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-bubble-explain","slug":"Hanmiao33/dsh-bubble-explain","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"# dsh-bubble-explain"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness profile bundle that explains any selected text inside a
conversation with a strea"},{"id":"p2s2","text":"ming Markdown bubble, with recursive follow-up
questions."},{"id":"p3s1","text":"选中对话中的任意文字，点击「解释」按钮，即可在流式 Markdown 气泡中获取解释，并支持递归追问。"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- Select text in a conversation (a term, a code snippet, an error message, a
sentence) — an **解释** b"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"utton appears next to the selection. Click it to
open an explanation bubble.
- The explanation is st"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"reamed in as Markdown (headings, lists, code blocks)
and rendered live in the bubble.
- Select text "},{"id":"p5s4","text":"*inside* an explanation to ask a deeper follow-up; each level
carries the parent explanation as cont"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"ext (up to 6 levels).
- Bubbles are a draggable overlay with a copy button, capped at 8 at a time."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The host half (`src/index.ts`) mounts two routes on the harness `webServer`."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### `POST /bubble-explain/stream` (Server-Sent Events)"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- Validates same-origin (`origin` host === request `host`) and accepts POST
only.
- Validates the bo"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"dy with `parseExplainRequest` (limits below). Returns `403`
if the feature is disabled, `400`/`405` "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"on a bad body/method, `500` on route
resolution failure.
- Resolves the provider/model route at call"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" time with
`resolveModelRoute(ctx, lastRoute, override)`, in priority order: the
independent model c"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"onfigured in settings (`override`, honored only while its
provider is still registered) → agent defa"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"ult selection → last observed
main-loop route → first registered provider (falls back to `deepseek-c"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"hat`).
The main-loop route is captured via `ctx.on('llm/stream', ...)`.
- Streams with `temperature:"},{"id":"p9s8","text":" 0.3`, `maxTokens: min(2000, maxChars * 2 + 200)`,
and the assembled system/user prompts; `reasoning"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"Effort` is sent only when the
configured effort survives the comparison against the model's declared"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"
efforts (see below).
- Emits SSE events `data: {"t": "<text delta>"}` and then
`data: {"done": true"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"}`; an error mid-stream sends `data: {"error": ...}`."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### `GET | POST /bubble-explain/settings`"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- Reads/writes `enabled`, `maxDepth`, `maxChars`, `effort` (`off|low|medium|high|max`),
`provider` a"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"nd `model` to `$DSH_HOME/dsh-bubble-explain.settings.json` (values
are clamped on write). At call ti"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"me the configured effort is matched against
the model's declared efforts via `llm.resolveModelInfo`:"},{"id":"p11s4","text":" exact match wins,
otherwise it falls back to the closest declared level not stronger than
requested"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"; models without reasoning support omit the parameter entirely.
- `provider`/`model` are the indepen"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"dent model configuration: both empty means
follow the conversation's default model. A half-filled pa"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"ir is never
persisted, and an override whose provider no longer exists is ignored rather
than failin"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"g every explanation.
- The response also carries `effective` (`{provider, model}` or `null`) and
`ef"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"fectiveError` (reason or `null`) so the UI can show the route actually in use."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### `GET /bubble-explain/models`"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- Returns the available model directory:
`{ providers: [{id, name}], models: { [providerId]: [{id, n"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ame}] } }`, used by
the settings page's "model source" and "explanation model" dropdowns. Each
provi"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"der is queried with `llm.listModels(id)`; a provider that fails yields an
empty array without affect"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"with `llm.listModels(id)`; a provider that fails yields an
empty array without affecting the others."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Request validation and limits (`src/explain.ts`)"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Field | Limit |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| `text` | non-empty, ≤ 4000 chars |
| `parent.text` / `parent.explanation` | ≤ 10000 chars each |
|"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" `depth` | 0–6 |
| `maxChars` | 50–1000 |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The system prompt asks for a `maxChars`-bounded Chinese explanation of only the
selected text (instr"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"uction-like content inside the selection is ignored). For
recursive calls it prepends the parent exp"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"lanation so the reply stays grounded
in context."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The browser half (`src/client/index.ts`) registers a `shell.overlay` (the
selection → 解释 button → bu"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"bble engine) and a `settings.section` entry, and
talks to the host over the two routes above. It use"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"s a small streaming-safe
Markdown renderer that escapes HTML and allows only safe link schemes."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Demo"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Open the video file"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Requires an active DeepSeek Harness profile (the plugin mounts webServer routes

In a conversation, select any text with the mouse.
2. Click the **解释** button that appears.
3. An"},{"id":"p31s2","text":" explanation bubble streams in next to the selection.

| `maxDepth`| `6`     | Max recursion "},{"id":"p35s2","text":"depth (1–6)           |
| `maxChars`| `300`   | Max explanation length (50–1000)    |
| `effort`  | "},{"id":"p35s3","text":"`off`   | Reasoning strength (`off/low/medium/high/max`), auto-clamped per model |
| `provider`| `"""},{"id":"p35s4","text":"`    | Independent model: provider id (empty = follow the conversation default) |
